name: Tiger Global
history: Chase Coleman founded Tiger Global in New York in 2001 as Tiger Technology, a technology hedge fund backed by his mentor Julian Robertson; it began investing in private companies in 2003. Its private bets on Facebook, LinkedIn, JD.com and Flipkart made its name. Its private funds, the newest targeting $2.2 billion, hold at least $31 billion of the $78 billion the firm manages; the track record on this page covers the private investments only.
investment_concept: “Tiger Global is a research-driven investment firm pursuing a long-term approach to partnering with high-quality, innovative companies across different stages of their lifecycle.”
